title: Inspect shape and dimensions
summary: Shape gives the size of each dimension. ndim tells you how many dimensions there are.
introduction: Shape gives the size of each dimension. ndim tells you how many dimensions there are. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Shape gives the size of each dimension. ndim tells you how many dimensions there are.

blocks.code:
import torch

x = torch.tensor([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
print(tuple(x.shape), x.ndim)
blocks.title: Inspect shape and dimensions

blocks.text: The output is (2, 2) 2. The tensor is a two-by-two table with two dimensions.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Two dimensions do not mean only two total values.
